title: Immortal King (Part 2)
flavor: For untold years, King Ostarion built a kingdom from the remains of his enemies. It was an obsessive errand, done to pass the long eternities of a monarchy that seemed fated never to end. Deeply mistrustful of flesh, he sought a more permanent way of extending his reign, and at last settled on pursuit of wraith energy, a form of pure spirit given off by certain dark souls at death. He infused himself and his warriors with Wraith Essence, creating bodies as luminous and eternal as his ego.

entries.name: Wraith King($5, Undead/Warrior)
entries.detail: Reworked. Upgraded from $4 to $5, and adjusted accordingly. Spectral Blade removed, and Reincarnation reworked into aura. Base damage increased from 115 to 175. <Aura> Grants deathrattle to all nearby allies whose level is no more than Wraith King: Reincarnation once directly on death. P.S. Non-permanent pieces cannot reincarnate. And pieces after reincarnation will be non-permanent pieces.

entries.name: Magic box
entries.detail: Reworked. All pieces can all count as targets. Consumes 1/3/9 stacks per Rank 1/2/3 pieces and transforms into new pieces of the same Level and Rank. <Relic Consumable: Click to Use> Packs an ally piece, at the beginning of next round, transforms it into a randon new piece of the same Level and Rank. 12 times available. P.S. Consumes 1/3/9 stacks per Rank 1/2/3 pieces. P.S. Packed pieces can be transformed into any piece of the same cost, despite the chess pool limit. P.S. Packed pieces will not transform into pieces you packed into before.

entries.detail: Reworked.
